Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Flag an out-of-scope issue for a separate background task.

Call this when you notice something worth fixing that would bloat the current change — dead code, stale docs, missing coverage, a confirmed TODO, or a security issue spotted in passing. Don't flag vague code-smell observations, trivial fixes you can do inline, or low-confidence hunches. A chip appears for the user; one click spins it off into its own session. Your current turn continues uninterrupted.

The prompt must stand alone — include file paths and enough context to act without this conversation.

The result includes a task_id; call dismiss_task with it if the suggestion later becomes stale.

## Cyrus v4b (feature/cyrus-v5~2) vs v6 studio: feature gap audit

I read the v4b files and the v6 files by ref. I ran no builds.

Both studios still call the same backend routes (`/api/mod-builder/builds/:id/{jar,source-zip,cancel,attachments}`, `PATCH /projects/:rootId`).

Bucket key: SU = studio-ui, COM = community/NxLabs, LC = lifecycle (install/enable/updates), RT = routing/categories.

| # | Feature | v4b implementation | v6 status | Bucket |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Explain tab** (tagline, how-to-use, commands with who-can-use, config keys with defaults, permissions, "Good to know") | `Explain.tsx` `Explain` | **Degraded.** There is no Explain tab. `lib/cyrus/real.ts` `realNotes()` renders the same data (commands, permissions, config, limits) as markdown in `preview/NotesTab.tsx` (Cyrus notes next to the user's own notes). The structured rows, "In plain English" hero and "What changed" are gone. | SU |
| 2 | **Safety check panel** (4 guarantees, warn findings, pass/notes pill) | `Explain.tsx` `Safety` | **Degraded.** Only one line in `realNotes()` ("Safety check: passed / passed with notes / blocked"). No findings or guarantee list. | SU |
| 3 | **Failure explanation** (error-code titles and tips, compiler output, "Stopped" state) | `Explain.tsx` `FAIL`, `failInfo`, `FailureDetails`, `Failure` | **Degraded.** `PreviewPanel.tsx` shows "This version didn't build" plus the raw `error` text and a note that held tokens are refunded. The per-code tips and the compiler `errorDetail` block are gone. Failed mods get a red state on the network node (`Network.tsx`). | SU |
| 4 | **Retry / Edit and retry** buttons | `Explain.tsx` `Failure` (Try again, Edit and retry, Describe something else for refused) | **Missing.** The user must retype the prompt. No retry or prefill-edit action exists in `PreviewPanel` or `PromptDock`. | SU |
| 5 | **Cancel / stop build** | Inspector "Stop this build" menu item, `/cancel` | **Present.** `PromptDock.tsx` (stop button) calls `forge.ts` `cancelForge()`, which POSTs `/cancel`. It only works for the build followed in the dock, not for other running builds. | n/a (done) |
| 6 | **Source viewer / file tree** | `LiveCode.tsx` `LiveCode`, `FilesList` (folders, "Related Files", live states) | **Present, improved.** `preview/FilesTab.tsx` is a collapsible tree. `preview/CodeView.tsx` has file tabs, highlighting and a copy button. | n/a |
| 7 | **Diff view between versions** | `DiffView.tsx` (unified/split, per-file added/removed/changed, show unchanged); `Versions.tsx` compare; changed-line glow in `LiveCode` | **Missing.** `lib/cyrus/diff.ts` (`diffLines`, `sideBySide`) is still in the tree, but no component imports it. `VersionsTab` shows "+adds/−dels" only for template mods and just the file count for real builds. | SU |
| 8 | **Version history, restore, branch** | `Versions.tsx` (lane map, compare, restore = `headBuildId`, "Branch from vN", "Make vN current / Go to current" banner) | **Degraded.** `preview/VersionsTab.tsx` is a timeline with model glyph, Paper version, status, View (read-only) and Restore. The `PreviewPanel` banner has Restore and Back to current. Lanes/branch-from-version and Compare are gone. Refining always builds on the active version (`PromptDock`). | SU |
| 9 | **Attachments / images display** | `Explain.tsx` `Request`: thumbnails via `/attachments/:n`, "Cyrus looked at these images" | **Degraded.** Upload, paste, drop and send still work (`PromptDock.tsx`, up to 4 images, 5MB). The saved-image display on a past build is gone; `attachments` meta is only stored (`lib/cyrus/meta.ts`). Screenshot capture (`getDisplayMedia`) is also gone. | SU |
| 10 | **Request quote** ("What you asked for" / "The change you asked for" + original description) | `Explain.tsx` `Request` | **Degraded.** `VersionsTab` shows each version's prompt as a 2-line quote. There is no original-vs-change split. | SU |
| 11 | **Model mark** (Katara/Saka/Yakko tier) | `icons.tsx` `ModelMark` in `Request` | **Present.** `icons/ModelGlyphs.tsx` in `VersionsTab` and `ModelSelect`. | n/a |
| 12 | **Estimates / minutes** | `lib/cyrus/estimate.ts` shown in Composer and `Request` ("usually ~x–y min"); `modelAdvice` | **Present in the composer.** `PromptDock.tsx` has `CyrusTokenEstimate` (`cyrus-tokens/TokenEstimate.tsx`, minutes plus tokens). The model-advice nudge and the estimate on running builds are gone. | n/a (minor) |
| 13 | **Paper version picker** | Composer version chip; locked to the target's version in change modes | **Present.** `PromptDock.tsx` "Paper {mcVersion}" select (`setMcVersion`). The lock for refinements is unconfirmed. | n/a |
| 14 | **Rename project** (double-click title) | `Inspector.tsx` `ModCard` → `PATCH {title}` | **Missing.** `ProjectPatch.title` is still supported in `lib/cyrus/meta.ts` and the store's `patchProject`. No UI calls it. | SU |
| 15 | **Favourite (star, `F` key)** | `Inspector.tsx` `ModCard` → `PATCH {favourite}` | **Missing.** `favourite` is carried in `real.ts` (`real.favourite`) but nothing renders or toggles it. | SU |
| 16 | **Delete / archive project** | Not in v4b (no UI, no archive in either version) | **Not a regression.** No delete or archive in either studio; an optional new feature. | SU |
| 17 | **Duplicate as new mod / Copy the request** (overflow menu) | `Inspector.tsx` menu, `onDuplicate` | **Missing** | SU |
| 18 | **Download .jar / source .zip** | Inspector menu + ModCard Download | **Present.** `PreviewPanel.tsx` download button (.jar) and `FilesTab` `onDownload` (source-zip). Template (non-real) mods get a client-side zip (`lib/cyrus/zip.ts`). Dropped: the jar name and size in the button title. | n/a |
| 19 | **Install to server** (Deploy Mod) | `Modals.tsx` `InstallModal` | **Present.** `kit/InstallModal.tsx` via the "Deploy" button, shown only for a succeeded real build. It is hidden below the `sm` breakpoint. | LC (done) |
| 20 | **Voice input** | `voice.ts` `useVoice` with a live level meter and the `V` key | **Present.** `prompt/VoiceButton.tsx` (Web Speech). The `V` shortcut and the waveform driving the aurora are gone. | n/a (minor) |
| 21 | **Keyboard shortcuts** (`N`, `[ ]`, `/`, `V`, `1–5`, `F`, `P`, `+ − 0`, `?` list, Esc) | `CyrusApp.tsx` handler, `Modals.tsx` `SHORTCUTS` / `ShortcutsModal` | **Degraded.** `CyrusApp.tsx` has Ctrl/⌘K (Cyrus's own `CommandPalette`, which overrides the portal's), `/` (focus prompt) and Esc (up one level / close panel). No `?` help modal, tab keys, `N`, `F` or `V`. | SU |
| 22 | **Live build log / stage view** | `Inspector.tsx` `BuildStrip` (stage track, queue position, repair "fix 1 of 3", last thoughts, elapsed); `LiveCode` typing code | **Mostly present.** `prompt/ThinkingTrace.tsx` (elapsed, model, step list) and code streaming into `CodeView`. Queue position and the "fix N of 3" repair counter are gone. | SU (minor) |
| 23 | **Search** (mods, files, games, "Ask Cyrus") | `Modals.tsx` `SearchPalette` | **Degraded.** `chrome/CommandPalette.tsx` covers games, categories, mods and actions. File search and "Ask Cyrus" are gone. | SU (minor) |
| 24 | **Empty state / welcome** (templates) | `Inspector.tsx` `Welcome`, `Modals.tsx` `TemplateLibrary` | **Present, different.** `prompt/StarterIdeas.tsx` chips plus the cosmos network. The template library modal is gone, but `lib/cyrus/templates.ts` and `engine/templates.ts` remain. | n/a |
| 25 | **Notes tab** | `Inspector.tsx` `Notes` (autosave, 4000-char limit) | **Present.** `preview/NotesTab.tsx` (autosave, plus Cyrus notes). | n/a |
| 26 | **"Built with Cyrus" badge** | `icons.tsx` `CyrusBadge` in Explain and the ModCard footer | **Degraded.** `kit/icons.tsx` still defines `CyrusBadge`, but no studio view renders it. Build summary line ("built in Xs · fixed itself N× · first try") is also gone. | SU, with COM (the badge is meant to go in the shipped mod/community listing) |
| 27 | **Share link** | `Inspector.tsx` Share button copies `/dashboard/cyrus/:id` | **Degraded.** `CyrusApp.tsx` keeps the URL in sync (`history.replaceState`, `/dashboard/cyrus/<buildId>`, deep link works). The Share/copy button is gone. | SU |
| 28 | **"Coming soon" teaser** for the Mods tab, NxLabs community and open source; disabled "View on NxLabs" button | `Explain.tsx` `cy-soon`; ModCard "View on NxLabs" | **Missing.** No publish-to-NxLabs entry point from the studio. The NxLabs pages (`components/nx/labs/cyrus/*`, `app/dashboard/nxlabs/cyrus`) exist outside the studio. | COM |
| 29 | **Per-mod categories** (classifier, "New … mod" templates in empty branches) | `lib/cyrus/categories.ts` and the web tree | **Present.** `lib/cyrus/categories.ts` still exists and `real.ts` `categoriesFor`. Not a gap. | RT (done) |
| 30 | **Server "Mods tab" enable/disable and update-tracking** | Listed in v4b only as "coming" | **Not in either studio.** Backed by `lib/cyrus-mods/installed.ts` and `lib/actions-cyrus-installed.ts`. | LC |

### Owner buckets for the gaps

- **studio-ui (the work):**
  - Explain tab restoration (commands, config, permissions, safety, failure tips and compiler output).
  - Retry and edit-and-retry.
  - DiffView and version compare, and branching from a version.
  - Rename, favourite, duplicate and copy-request.
  - Attachments thumbnails on past builds.
  - Request quote with original description.
  - Share button, keyboard-shortcut set and `?` help, file search.
  - Queue position and repair counter in the live view.
  - Rendering `CyrusBadge`.
- **community/NxLabs:** the "View on NxLabs" / publish entry point and the community teaser, plus the badge linking to the listing.
- **lifecycle:** nothing was lost. Install still works. Server-side enable/disable and updates remain a separate surface.
- **routing/categories:** none lost.
- **other:** Delete/archive never existed in v4b, so it is new work, not a regression. The v4b design notes (`/root/agent-notes/cyrus-v4/ROUNDS.md`) list Explain, Versions map/compare, Files, search palette and Failure with Try again / Edit and retry as shipped in v4/v4b. All of those except Files and search are gone or degraded in v6.

### Notes

- The biggest functional regressions are the Explain tab (1–3), failure recovery (3–4) and DiffView/compare (7). The data and helpers for all three still exist (`realNotes()`, `lib/cyrus/diff.ts`, `lib/cyrus/meta.ts` `ProjectPatch`), so restoring them is mostly UI work.
- For rename and favourite, only the missing buttons need adding: the store's `patchProject` already accepts `title` and `favourite`.
- Two caveats: the Paper version lock for refinements and the `PreviewPanel` Deploy button's hiding below `sm` are unconfirmed or mobile-only.
